title: RFL embodiment descriptor
description: Validates an RFL embodiment descriptor (the JSON / YAML form of the <rfl:capabilities> manifest). Structure per 03-driver-interface.md (frame model, capability manifest, limits, sensor descriptor) and 04-tactile-manifold.md (contact-sensor descriptor); file format owned by 02-translation-layer.md. Backs conformance test class 1 (parser conformance, 05-conformance.md). Quantities are unit-suffixed strings (e.g. "20 N"), the JSON/YAML equivalent of the spec's XML value+unit attributes.

Quantity.description: A numeric value with a unit, e.g. "20 N", "0.05 m/s", "60 deg", "1.5 m/s^2".

SignedAxis.description: A signed principal axis of a frame, e.g. "+z".

id.description: Stable, unique embodiment id (03 § Embodiment identity).

allOf.$comment: M2 — the reach baseline limits are mandatory for every embodiment (reach is the assumed-present baseline; 03 § Reach baseline limits).
M2 — grasp.precision_tripod (the table's grasp.tripod row; the ISA id is precision_tripod).
M2 — grasp.pin: extrinsic force closure, the external surface bears the load, so no payload limit.
M2 — grasp.envelope: form closure, enclosure_range is a [min, max] range.
M2 — grasp.hook: form closure with a directional hold, no opposing grip force.
M2 — grasp.platform: balance-held support, no closing grip (placement-motion bound v_cartesian_max, not v_grasp).
M2 — transport.handoff: the combined-force ceiling for the dual-grasp window (IHT2c). transport base v/a_cartesian_max are covered by the reach baseline.
M2 — transport.carry: the carry stability headroom default (IHT2c).
M2 — force.wipe: hybrid force/position control requires normal-direction compliance (CMP2c).
M2 — force.scrub: normal-direction compliance plus the oscillation-rate ceiling (PFS2c + CMP2c).
M2 — in_hand.rotate: angular in-hand velocity plus the grasp-mode-keyed rotation range (IHT1c).
M2 — in_hand.translate: linear in-hand velocity plus the grasp-mode-keyed translation range (IHT1c).
M2 — in_hand.roll: angular in-hand velocity (no range limit).
M2 — in_hand.flip: angular in-hand velocity. (in_hand.regrasp adds no limit; place / sense add no new embodiment limit, PFS4c.)

Frames.description: Embodiment frame model (03 § Embodiment frame model). Roles, never body parts.

role_defaults.description: Default frame per manipulation role. grasp is the minimum; a tactile default is absent on a non-tactile embodiment.

skills.description: Asserted capability keys (03 § Capability manifest). Each is a Skill ISA primitive id other than reach.* (reach is the mandatory baseline and carries no capability key, 03 § Primitive capabilities), one of the four category keys transport / in_hand / force / sense (the category gates 03 defines; grasp is declared per mode and place is composition-gated, so neither has a bare category key), or an ext.<ns>.<name> extension key (06). The primitive-id set is exactly skill-isa.schema.json's PrimitiveId enum minus reach.*; an unknown skill id is rejected (03 § URDF / MJCF binding).

aux.description: Auxiliary capabilities (03 § Auxiliary capabilities). Known keys are typed below; an unknown auxiliary name must carry a namespace prefix (06), so extra keys stay permitted. Absence of tactile_sensing routes grasp/force confirmation to the force/position proxy (04).

tactile_sensing.description: Contact sensing present. Preferred by every grasp.* but never required: when absent, confirmation degrades to the force/position proxy (04).

compliance.description: The set of compliance modes the embodiment provides (03 § Compliance capability), each one of passive / active / virtual; a single mode may be written as a bare scalar shorthand. Distinct from the per-primitive compliance request, which omits virtual (01).

tool_safety.description: Hazardous-tool safety capability (03 § Tool-safety capability), required by force.cut. RFL does not define the standard.

hazard_class.description: the hazard managed (cut / shear; extensible to weld, thermal, ... via 06)

standard.description: reference to the deployment safety standard the capability claims to satisfy

human_collaboration_safety.description: Human-collaboration safety capability (03 § Human-collaboration safety capability), required by place.hand_to. Carries the two defaults the primitive's auto values resolve to (SAF3c). The dependency on a declared compliance mode (SAF4c) is a cross-field rule verified by the conformance suite, not this schema.

standard.description: reference to the human-collaboration safety standard (ISO 10218 / 13482 context, or the deployment equivalent)

weight_transfer_threshold.description: fraction of weight a human must take before release (a bare ratio, no unit, e.g. 0.5)

coordination_channel.description: Ability to participate in inter-robot handoff coordination (03 § Coordination-channel capability). Its absence makes a handoff to a remote receiver return coordination_unavailable.

Limits.description: Flat namespace embodiment.limits.* (03 § Limits). Each value is a quantity or a [min, max] range, except the two in-hand range limits, which are maps keyed by grasp mode (03 § In-hand capabilities).

stability_margin.description: transport.carry stability headroom (03 § Transport capabilities): a dimensionless ratio, so a bare number rather than a unit-suffixed quantity.

GraspModeRangeMap.description: An in-hand workspace range keyed by grasp mode (03 § In-hand capabilities): the range a grasp affords depends on which grasp holds the object, so this is a map rather than a scalar. Each value is a [min, max] range.

TactileMap.description: Contact-sensor descriptor, keyed by tactile-role frame (04 § The contact-sensor descriptor). The whole block is absent on an embodiment that does not declare tactile_sensing.

sensor_class.description: The per-sensor-class adapter (04 § The adapter mapping) whose raw -> feature mapping produces this frame's features; the declared `features` MUST be a subset of that adapter's produced features (validate.py C6). A core token (ft / array / visuotactile / pneumatic) or an ext.<ns>.<class> registered class (06).

sites.description: Discrete contact-site count, or a dense-grid layout (extent + spacing). Only the discrete count is exercised in v0.1.

features.description: The features this frame reports, drawn from the closed-core taxonomy (04 § Feature taxonomy) or, beyond the core, an ext.<vendor>.<feature> extension feature the registry namespaces (06). The core stays fixed so the conformance suite can enumerate it.

SensorMap.description: Non-contact sensor descriptor, keyed by sensor-role frame (03 § Sensor descriptor).
